insert.foreach: INSERT INTO T_ECC_ORMEMBER_MENU( ORGID , TITLEID , MENUID , STATUS ) VALUES( #{item.orgId}, #{item.titleId}, #{item.menuId}, #{item.status} )

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_ECC_ORMEMBER_MENU OM WHERE OM.ORGID =#{orgId} AND OM.TITLEID=#{titleId}
DELETE FROM T_ECC_EMP_MENU EM WHERE EM.EMPID=#{empId}
mapper.select: SELECT OM.MENUID FROM T_ECC_ORMEMBER_MENU OM WHERE OM.STATUS='1' AND OM.ORGID =#{orgId} AND OM.TITLEID=#{titleId}
SELECT EM.MENUID FROM T_ECC_EMP_MENU EM WHERE EM.STATUS='1' AND EM.EMPID=#{empId}

SELECT COUNT(M.MENUID) FROM T_ECC_MENU M JOIN T_ECC_EMP_MENU EM ON M.MENUID=EM.MENUID JOIN T_ECC_EMPLOYEE EMP ON EMP.EMPID=EM.EMPID WHERE EMP.STAT='STAR' AND EMP.EMPID=#{empId} AND M.MURL LIKE #{requestPath}||'%'

SELECT COUNT(M.MENUID) FROM T_ECC_MENU M JOIN T_ECC_ORMEMBER_MENU OM ON M.MENUID=OM.MENUID JOIN T_ECC_ORMEMBER O ON O.ORGID=OM.ORGID AND O.TITLEID=OM.TITLEID WHERE O.STAT='STAR' AND O.EMPID=#{empId} AND M.MURL LIKE #{requestPath}||'%'
